title: Seafarer Vacation Rental
meta_description: Seafarer is a 2.00 bedroom, 2.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: DescriptionSeafarerSeacrest Beach Area, 30AHome Highlights:Fully remodeled in 20232 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, sleeps 4 (see “Room Details” tab for configurations)2-story beachfront townhome with stunning Gulf viewsPrivate beach access directly from your patioTVs in every bedroom with private bathroomsPatio and balcony with beautiful Gulf viewsFully equipped kitchen and spacious living roomWasher/DryerGas grill2 free beach chairs, 1 umbrella, and 1 side table (March 1 – October 31)Off-street parking for 2 carsPets not allowed (service animals only; documentation required)Seafarer is perched atop the sugar-white dunes of scenic 30A, offering the perfect combination of luxury and comfort for an unforgettable beach getaway. Relax on the furnished balcony or patio while taking in panoramic views of the Gulf.The first floor features a fully equipped kitchen and a spacious living room with large sliding glass doors opening to the patio and beach. Upstairs, the master bedroom boasts a king bed and Gulf views, while the guest bedroom also features a king bed and private balcony.Located between Rosemary Beach and Seaside, Seafarer is within walking or biking distance to charming shops, restaurants, and nightlife. Spend your days on the beautiful beaches of the Emerald Coast and your evenings exploring all that 30A has to offer.ParkingOff-street parking for 2 vehiclesReservation & Booking PolicyCheck-in: 4:00 PM (CST) | Check-out: 10:00 AM (CST)Tenant must be at least 25 years old and occupy the home during the rental period50% of total cost due at booking; balance due 30 days prior to arrival (or in full if within 60 days)Cancellations over 30 days in advance: full refund minus 5% processing feeCancellations less than 30 days: non-refundableOptional travel insurance available (must be purchased before final payment)NO SMOKINGPublished rates do not include taxes and feesCancellation policies from 30A Cottages & Concierge Vacation Rental Agreement override third-party booking sitesSeafarer is your ideal 30A escape—luxury, comfort, and unbeatable beachfront views await!
